verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Veriff's document- and biometric-based verification flows (session creation, SDKs, webhooks, liveness) plus a PEP/Sanctions add-on, but nothing shows a no-document database-only check against SSN, national registry, or credit-header data. missing for 10: any API/doc showing a no-doc data-only verification mode, evidence of SSN/registry/credit-header lookups.
